headline: Bag enable toggles and Size settings now live on each bag's own settings page, including a new Vendor page.

entries.title: Vendor page in BetterBags Next settings
entries.details: Adds a Vendor page under Bags in BetterBags Next with General and Size tabs. Because the vendor window does not file items in categories, it has no item or category settings.

entries.title: Per-bag Size settings replace Appearance > Size
entries.details: Moves Icon Scale, Bag Scale, Autosize (was Autosize Bags), and Fit Names While Open from Appearance > Size to each bag's Size tab in BetterBags Next. Bags scale separately, custom values carry over, Vendor Autosize defaults to off, and the Food & Drink bar uses the backpack's Icon Scale.

entries.title: Bag enable toggles moved to each bag's General tab
entries.details: Moves Enable Bank Bags, Enable Guild Bank Window, and Enable Vendor Window from General to a new General tab on the Bank, Guild Bank, and Vendor pages in BetterBags Next. General keeps settings shared by every bag.
